# Spectator Visibility

Source: [wiki article 4834](../archive/4834.md); edited 2024-11-26.

<a id="wiki-4834-n1"></a>

- Default Visibility exposes text to non-team spectators only when all players can see it; explicit Always/Never override that policy.
